name: @projexlight/sdk-meter
summary: Universal metering for ProjexCloud: every billable action (API call, MB processed, AI token, evidence frame) flows through emitUsage(); rates resolve against a versioned pricing_catalog; soft caps stamp WARN headers; hard caps DENY. Emits usage.events.v1 to Kafka so sdk-billing + analytics can aggregate independently. The pricing-catalog versioning means historical invoices stay reproducible after rate bumps.

endpoints.description: Liveness probe; confirms catalog + Kafka emitter connectivity.
List published pricing catalogs across versions.
Publish a new pricing catalog version.
Set or update a rate for a specific SKU within a catalog.

events.name: meter.usage.event.v1
events.description: Per-call usage event emitted on every metered operation. Partitioned by tenant_id in Kafka.

events.name: meter.usage.aggregated.v1
events.description: Hourly / daily rollups computed by the meter-collector service; consumed by sdk-billing.live + invoice generation.

events.name: meter.catalog.published.v1
events.description: New catalog version published; sdk-billing pins existing invoices to the old version and uses the new for future periods.

events.name: meter.softcap.exceeded.v1
events.description: Tenant breached a soft cap on a SKU; downstream stamps WARN headers and surfaces in tenant-admin billing.

events.name: meter.hardcap.denied.v1
events.description: Tenant breached a hard cap; request denied with 429. P7 phase flips soft caps to hard caps once tenants are migrated.

models.description: Catalog header (id, version, status, currency, effective_from, effective_to).
Per-(catalog, sku) rate row. Rate is decimal, supports tiered pricing via JSON metadata.
Per-(tenant, sku) soft / hard cap thresholds + alert routing.
Daily roll-up table queried by sdk-billing.live; partitioned by day for fast retention pruning.
Log of every hard-cap denial; surfaced to tenant admin + billing dunning.

hooks.name: emitUsage
hooks.description: Universal metering entry point. Every other SDK calls this on every billable operation. Idempotent on (tenant_id, dedup_key).

hooks.name: registerSoftCapResolver
hooks.description: Plug a resolver that decides which soft-cap applies for a given (tenant_id, sku) — defaults to reading meter.quota_policy.

hooks.name: registerCurrentUsageResolver
hooks.description: Plug a fast-path lookup for current-period usage so soft-cap checks stay O(1) (uses Redis when available).

hooks.name: setEmitter
hooks.description: Swap the default in-process emitter for a Kafka emitter (production); used at api-gateway startup when KAFKA_ENABLED=true.

scenarios.title: Emit a usage event from any SDK on every billable call
scenarios.when_to_use: Every billable call across ProjexCloud (encrypt, decrypt, login, MFA challenge, AI inference, scaffold, etc.).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Idempotent — same dedup_key counted at most once. Writes to in-process buffer (or Kafka when KAFKA_ENABLED). Flows to meter.usage_ledger_day within ~60 s. Triggers soft-cap / hard-cap gates if thresholds exceeded.

scenarios.title: Publish a new pricing catalog version (quarterly bump)
scenarios.when_to_use: Finance rolls out a rate change; old invoices stay pinned to the prior catalog, new periods price against the new one.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Emits meter.catalog.published.v1. New invoices generated by sdk-billing for periods starting after the catalog's effective_from use the new rates. Existing finalized invoices are immutable.

scenarios.title: Tenant exceeds a soft cap; WARN header stamped, request still succeeds
scenarios.when_to_use: Pre-GA / trial customers should not be hard-denied — surface the breach so they can decide to upgrade.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request succeeds with the WARN header. Emits meter.softcap.exceeded.v1 (rate-limited per tenant+sku to avoid spam). Tenant-admin Billing page surfaces the yellow badge.

scenarios.title: Hard cap exceeded — request denied with 429 + structured reason
scenarios.when_to_use: P7+ tenants where the soft-cap → hard-cap migration has completed; hard caps prevent surprise bills.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request denied. quota_denial row written. Emits meter.hardcap.denied.v1. Tenant admin can request a temporary lift via the Approvals flow (sdk-approval).

scenarios.title: Background meter verifier reconciles per-day rollups against the raw event log
scenarios.when_to_use: Daily compliance check that meter.usage_ledger_day matches the sum of meter.usage.event.v1 events; catches dropped messages or rollup bugs.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Drift below 0.1% logs as INFO. Drift above pages on-call. Fixed by re-running the rollup with the verified raw event set.

compliance_posture.notes: Usage events are themselves audit-chain entries via sdk-audit. Pricing catalog version pinning satisfies SOX revenue-recognition immutability. Tenants in regulated jurisdictions have the option of having their usage events held in-region (set USAGE_EVENTS_REGIONAL_HOLD=true).

pricing_skus.unit_description: per usage event accepted (free up to plan ceiling; rarely a hot SKU itself)
